_comment: Bajaj Allianz Private Car SATP (standalone-TP) model PO, USER 2026-06-26. Tiers are FIRST-match-wins, so order matters. (1) 2.5% no-payout tier FIRST: CNG/LPG fuel (any model) + Baleno/Dzire models — a CNG Swift is 2.5%, not 25%. (2) 25% tier: Swift/Beat/Fiesta/I20, SET to 0.25 (region SATP always >=25; a min cap would keep stray low rows e.g. Mumbai Beat 0.05). SWIFT excludes 'Swift Dzire' so it falls to the 2.5% tier (Dzire). All matched by model/fuel token, any make.
